title.zh: 将哥打巴托省Kabagan市镇Banawa村的名称正式变更为Banawag的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio of Banawa, in the Municipality of Kabagan, Province of Cotabato, to Banawag
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio of Banawa, in the Municipality of Kabagan, Province of Cotabato, to Banawag
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Banawa tại Thị trấn Kabagan, Tỉnh Cotabato thành Banawag
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Banawa ในเทศบาล Kabagan, จังหวัด Cotabato เป็น Banawag
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Banawa di Kotamadya Kabagan, Provinsi Cotabato menjadi Banawag
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Banawa di Perbandaran Kabagan, Wilayah Cotabato menjadi Banawag

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1954/ra_1034_1954.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio of Banawa, in the Municipality of Kabagan, Province of Cotabato, is hereby changed to Banawag.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1954.
